name: Shokuma Gaiden 4 ~Miko Hobaku Hen~
source:
Ayame is a shrine maiden and exorcist. She senses the presence of a demon, and heads for a deserted house outside of town.
There she finds a pair of sisters in captivity, who are being sexually violated.
Ayame challenges the demon in order to free the sisters, but she is captured herself and subjected to sexual abuse.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ037434.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
绫女是巫女兼驱魔师。她感觉到恶魔的存在，于是前往城外的一所废弃的房子。
在那里，她发现一对被囚禁的姐妹，她们正在遭受性侵犯。
绫雨为了释放姐妹俩而挑战恶魔，但她自己却被俘虏并遭受性虐待。
